QuestInfo.name: [Alliance Mission] Expedition Mission - Black Hole
QuestInfo.1:
Before you get sucked into the black hole, defeat the monsters and report back to #b#p3003564##k to complete the Expedition mission.

While defeating monsters in the #bWorld's Sorrow#k, Orchid will appear #roccasionally#k and open a black hole.
QuestInfo.2: You avoided the black hole, defeated the monsters, and completed the Expedition mission. Whew!
